subject: Film & Cinema
title: Rule of Thirds and Visual Balance
description: A 60-second lesson on Rule of Thirds and Visual Balance.

hook.text: Place a character dead center and they look boring. Shift them to the side and they come alive.

buildup.text: The rule of thirds divides the frame into a grid — placing subjects at intersections feels natural.

discovery.text: This principle comes from painting and photography — cinema inherited it wholesale.

twist.text: Kubrick broke the rule constantly, centering characters for an unsettling, symmetrical effect.

climax.text: Knowing the rule matters. Knowing when to break it matters more.

punchline.text: Rules create harmony. Breaking them creates power.

quiz.question: How did Kubrick often break the rule of thirds?
options: He placed characters dead center for an unsettling, symmetrical effect
